rounds.meaning: go ba le lerato goba go nyaka selo
rounds.story: Reta e ra go tumiša. E ngwalwa e batametše rata, eupša ga e bolele lerato goba go nyaka selo.
Teba e ra go lebelela ka kelohloko goba go nepiša. E swana le tseba ka go ngwala, eupša ga se go tseba selo.

rounds.meaning: go hwetša selo ka go se lefela
rounds.story: Rera e ra go loga leano goba go bolela thero. E swana le reka ka tlhaka, eupša ga e bolele go reka selo.

rounds.meaning: go notlolla goba go bulega ga selo se tswaletšwego
rounds.story: Bola e ka ra go bola ga selo. E swana le bula ka go ngwala, eupša ga e bolele go notlolla selo.

rounds.meaning: go belega goba go ba motswadi wa ngwana
rounds.story: Tšwela e ra go tšwa pele goba go tšwela pele. E batametše tswala ka modumo, eupša ga e bolele go belega.

rounds.meaning: go ntšha mantšu le go bua
rounds.story: Boela e ra go boa gape. E swana le bolela ka ponagalo, eupša ga e bolele go bua goba go ntšha mantšu.
Apaya e ra go apea dijo. E thoma ka ditlhaka tše di swanago le apara, eupša ga e bolele diaparo.

rounds.meaning: go tsoga borokong goba go emelela godimo
rounds.story: Tšhoga e ra go boifa goba go tšhoga. E batametše tsoga ka modumo, eupša ga e bolele go tsoga borokong.
Lemoga e ra go hlokomedšiša goba go lemoga selo. E swana le lema ka go ngwala, eupša ga e bolele tša tšhemo.

rounds.meaning: go dumela motho goba go ba le kholofelo
rounds.story: Tshega e ra go sega. E swana le tshepa ka ditlhaka tše dingwe, eupša ga e bolele kholofelo goba go dumela motho.
